text:
maria (oncall): seeing a flood of `alertbridge` failures and a bunch of pages never delivered. customers are reporting degraded UX. paging count stuck in queue :exclamation:

sre-runbook-bot: [ALERTBRIDGE] 3109876543 - 5 failures to pager provider in last 2m, 401 responses from paging API, token-expired suspected.

jonathan: I didn't get any pages — my phone shows nothing. did the oncall rotation change? :confused:

alice: I see missing handoffs on the handoff audit. the `oncall_rotation` webhook returned 200 but the body was empty for two ops users.

kevin: jumping in. checking bridge logs now. tailing /var/log/bridge/pager.log
```
kevin: 2026-11-09T12:02:11Z ERROR pager.send failed status=401 body="{\"error\":\"invalid_token\"}"
kevin: 2026-11-09T12:02:12Z INFO replay queue size=82
```

maria (oncall): opsbot didn't escalate either, I only saw the channel alert. I had to DM jonathan manually to get eyes on it. customers impacted: 3 SOC partners, one on dedicated infra.

opsbot: automation note: rotation-run triggered at 2026-11-09T11:59:00Z; token-rotate job returned exit=1. See job id job_20261109_1159.

alice: token-rotate cron was updated last week to rotate via KMS proxy. hypothesis: KMS proxy auth rotated keys and the bridge failed to refresh cached creds.

jonathan: can we manually requeue the pending pages while we fix token flow?

kevin: requeued 82 pending pages to immediate queue and triggered manual delivery. monitoring delivery receipts...

kevin: update: 54/82 delivered, 28 still failing with 401. Provider indicates token rejected.

maria (oncall): I can call the provider support, but we need customers notified. alex from support is on it, pinged in #support. tagging @alice to draft a short blast.

alice: drafting message for customers now. short status: "Pager delivery delays; on-call escalations were partially affected; mitigation in progress; manual pages being sent". will post in support thread.

jonathan: mitigation steps so far: 1) requeue 2) restart bridge service to force credential reload 3) run token-rotate job manually with verbose logging 4) fallback: manual SMS for critical customers.

kevin: restarted bridge: `systemctl restart alertbridge` at 12:14Z. logs show bridge obtained new token from KMS proxy but token payload missing `scope` field -> provider rejects it.

opsbot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/alertbridge-auth - follow section B for provider-token mismatch.

maria (oncall): manual paging completed for the 3 affected customers. support confirmed two raised Sev2s, one informational only. no customer data lost; only delayed notifications.

alice: I'm running token-rotate locally with debug:```
alice: curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"service":"alertbridge"}'
alice: response: {"token":"ey...","meta":{"expires":"2026-11-09T13:14:00Z"}}
```

alice: but when bridge requests `/fetch-token` it gets `{"token":"ey...","meta":{}}` — meta.scope missing. investigating proxy transform.

jonathan: quick mitigation: added temporary shim in bridge to accept missing scope and add default scope `pager:deliver` to token payload. deployed patch to canary and pushed to prod.

kevin: canary accepted, full deploy started at 12:32Z. delivery success rate improved to 96%. remaining failures are due to provider rate limits after retry storm. throttling quieting down.

maria (oncall): customers updated. we've escalated to engineering for root cause. action items: 1) postmortem in 24h 2) add integration test for token schema 3) revert shim once proxy fixed 4) improve alert that shows when pages remain queued > 5m.

opsbot: creating incident ticket INC-2026-9876 and scheduling postmortem.

jonathan: thanks everyone. pairing notes and runbook updates will be in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
